authorProcess: Claude Code session (Research Intelligence PHASE 2, STEP 17) — design only; no forcing acquired, no model run
releaseRule: release points = t0 observed positions of the window's cohort-assigned drifters only (IDs first added in that window); duplicate IDs are not released; comparison pairs = 23

domainRule.current: t0 cohort bounding box of the window's cohort drifters with a fixed buffer of 2.0 degree in latitude and 2.0 degree in longitude; latitude domain clipped to [-40, +40]
domainRule.wind: ocean forcing domain ± 3.0°, time t0-12h .. t0+84h
domainRule.bufferRationale: 72 h × 0.85 m/s ≈ 220 km was the prior basis for choosing the initial spatial margin only; the implementation applies the geographic degree extent as stated, never a guaranteed km distance
domainRule.boundaryPolicy: latitude domain [-40, +40]; no extrapolation outside; states are OUT_OF_DOMAIN (particle leaves the ocean domain) or FORCING_UNAVAILABLE (no forcing sample at that time/position); cohort kept; recorded per window forcing status; no reader extension for the 0.04° grid poleward of ±40° without a new preregistration

currentPrimary.coordinateConvention: lon -180..180 as requested, lat ascending, float32 labels normalized to 2 dp (<1e-4° correction)
currentPrimary.qualityFlags: masked-node count and u/v ranges recorded; release stencil must be fully wet
currentPrimary.coastlineTreatment: none in forcing; cohort rule E4 (>100 km) already applied
currentPrimary.download: NCSS 4 requests per window (21h+21h+21h+1 frame), 25 frames exactly
currentPrimary.license: DoD Distribution A, unlimited distribution (file distribution_statement)
currentPrimary.checksum: SHA-256 per original file + canonical-list aggregate per window; normalized grid sha256 with fixed issuedAt
currentPrimary.reproducibility: saved originals are canonical; re-download registered as new version

currentProductAxis.temporalResolution: daily mean (kept as is; not resampled to 3 h)
currentProductAxis.verticalLevel: 15 m by linear interpolation between adjacent levels (~13.47 m, ~15.81 m; confirm from file)
currentProductAxis.independenceStatement: independent model/assimilation system; shared assimilated observations (altimetry, SST, Argo) — not 'fully independent'

wind.coordinateConvention: lat reversed to ascending with data; lon 0..360 → -180..180
wind.alternative: ERA5 10 m only after CDS credentials and a separate preregistration; sensitivity axis only

qcPolicy.frameCompleteness: 25 HYCOM frames at 3 h exactly, 16+ wind frames at 6 h; any gap → window FORCING_BLOCKED (no substitution)
qcPolicy.coverage: release points inside both boxes with full wet stencil; else preflight rejects
qcPolicy.validity: u/v finite within ±5 m/s current, ±120 m/s wind; masked fraction reported

provenancePolicy.manifest: docs/research/step17-forcing-manifest.json: per file query, retrievedAtUTC, httpStatus, bytes, sha256; per window forcingSha256
provenancePolicy.normalized: grid sha256 + sourceSha256 + processingHistory; regenerable by tools/research/build_step17_forcing.py
provenancePolicy.storage: originals under data/research/step17/ (committed if small) ; normalized JSON regenerable (.gitignore policy as STEP 9)

checksumPolicy: SHA-256 everywhere; aggregate = sha256(canonical JSON of sorted [{filename, sha256, bytes}])
acquisitionOrder: build_step17_forcing.py reads cohort-step16.json only to size boxes
prohibited: choosing datasets/thresholds for a drifter, date or outcome
reducing the domain margin after acquisition

forcingRoles.independentOceanProduct: GLORYS12V1 (Copernicus Marine) — not a substitute for HYCOM; if credentials are absent: GLORYS STATUS = BLOCKED/PENDING, HYCOM+NCEP primary proceeds, GLORYS-dependent axes are not run until acquired

credentialPolicy.acquisition: user provides Copernicus Marine credentials at acquisition time; never stored or committed
credentialPolicy.secrets: username/password/API token/credential files are never committed; .gitignore checked beforehand

prohibited: removing AG-2 (1 drifter) or KE-2 (5 drifters) windows

lockPolicy: after LOCK no change to forcing source, variables, resolution, domain, buffer, temporal window, interpolation, QC, missing policy, alpha or run definition; changes require a new ruleId
nextStep: STEP 17 — PHASE B: FORCING ACQUISITION + QC (separate step; nothing acquired in Phase A)
